heading: More ways to start a project, and agents explained
body: Start a project has 8 more kinds: spreadsheet or budget, document or report, slide deck, online store, event, YouTube or podcast channel, course or training, and game mod. Ready-made templates for common businesses, such as a bakery website, a realtor listing campaign and a contractor quote sheet: use one as it is, or Save a copy to make it your own. Templates can be exported as a file and imported again, for example to share one with a teammate; files with keys or passwords in them are refused. The Agents page starts with a short explanation of what agents do and what happens when you use one. The Live feed can tuck away to the side: press Hide, and a thin tab counts new events until you open it again. Meldmind remembers your choice. An AI that has been shut down, like Gemini CLI, is removed from Settings and every list instead of showing as off.
